# PR #414 replacement review

**Audit date:** 2026-10-21 (America/New_York); source checks completed 2026-10-22 UTC.

**Pinned baselines:** [main `7c034569`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/tree/7c034569b908d3b03a8b821b7c537477a24b10f7) and the original Claude draft PR #414 at [`42d72871`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/tree/42d728716bf0c6ee2450fcee3f9b50cbaed061f8).

This review reads the original PR's `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md` and `AGENTS.md`, the pinned main audit dated 2026-10-17, issue [#380](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/issues/380), and representative source/revision/citation, agent-grant/task, and Workflow code. It is read-only. No tests, production inventory, cutover, runtime change or current performance measurement were performed.

**Status:** The findings below describe gaps in the original Claude draft at `42d728716bf0c6ee2450fcee3f9b50cbaed061f8`. The revised [Architecture](../../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), [Implementation](../../../docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md), and [Replacement map](../../../docs/MAP.md) now state the corresponding product, data-preservation and transition requirements. This is documentation-level correction; the new runtime and its data migration still need to be implemented and verified. No production row counts, schema totals or performance results are asserted here. The pinned main tree contains 3,282 file blobs and 152 files under `infra/d1/core/migrations/`; those are source-tree counts only.

## Current source observations that shape the replacement

These are reproducible observations at `7c034569`, not a fresh latency benchmark or a claim that each
mechanism is independently a production bug. They explain where the replacement removes accumulated work.

| Observed source | Consequence for the replacement |
|---|---|
| [Managed project search](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/7c034569b908d3b03a8b821b7c537477a24b10f7/packages/cloudflare-ai/src/project-search.ts#L79-L176) reads and validates a generation registry, checks its canonical JSON/hash, and rechecks registry identity after native search. | Use native selected-revision search plus membership/deletion checks. Remove promotion/registry proof from the ordinary query path; measure actual improvement after implementation. |
| [Ingest commit](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/7c034569b908d3b03a8b821b7c537477a24b10f7/packages/platform-cloudflare/src/d1-ingest-commit.ts#L196-L230) reconciles prepared-operation policy, admission/qualification and promotion/bundle receipts before storing the source. | Keep stable source/revision/job identity and atomic publication, with readable data independent of enrichment. Do not transplant the receipt hierarchy into the new schema. |
| [Investigation transitions](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/7c034569b908d3b03a8b821b7c537477a24b10f7/packages/domain/src/investigation.ts#L5-L25) define 18 ordered stages and validate transitions against the next stage. | Replace that fixed research programme with one bounded gap-driven loop. Preserve useful plans, progress, evidence and saved results, not each stage and its associated machinery. |
| [Worker asset configuration](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/7c034569b908d3b03a8b821b7c537477a24b10f7/apps/eliotr-core/wrangler.jsonc#L18-L35) points to `eliotr-pwa/dist`, while the repository also contains the React `eliotr-web` application. | The selected replacement has one served React/Vite UI. Migration must change the real asset/build route as well as components. This checked-in configuration alone does not establish the currently deployed route. |

## Stale example in the 2026-10-17 audit

The older audit's [duplicate-owner-client row](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/7c034569b908d3b03a8b821b7c537477a24b10f7/.github/audits/2026-10-17/README.md#L74) points to code at its older `4e53d5e` baseline. That characterization is stale at pinned main `7c034569`: [`runtime.ts`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/7c034569b908d3b03a8b821b7c537477a24b10f7/apps/eliotr-web/src/app/runtime.ts#L102-L112) creates one bound `binary` owner client and passes that instance to the legacy adapter; [`http.ts`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/7c034569b908d3b03a8b821b7c537477a24b10f7/packages/owner-api-client/src/legacy/http.ts#L114-L115) accepts an injected client. Runtime session verification separately creates and disposes a short-lived bootstrap probe at [`runtime.ts:186-203`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/7c034569b908d3b03a8b821b7c537477a24b10f7/apps/eliotr-web/src/app/runtime.ts#L186-L203); that is not a second client owned by the bound API adapter. Do not carry the old duplicate-client claim forward as a current blocker without new evidence.

The revised documents are requirements and transition guidance, not implementation proof. Runtime remediation, data reconciliation, deployment and acceptance remain future work.

## Contributor instructions and retained fixtures

The pinned main tree has 20 nested `AGENTS.md` files in addition to the root. Several direct contributors to
superseded packets, ADRs and instructions removed by the original PR. This revision consolidates applicable
reading, preservation and coordination rules into [root AGENTS](../../../AGENTS.md) and removes those nested
copies. The root remains the single active contributor entry point; the historical versions remain at the
pinned main commit.

Legacy contract fixtures and `docs/implementation/implementation-status.json` remain because current scripts
read them. The reviewed status checker follows code markers, not its historical documentation-link strings.
Neither `fast-ci.yml` nor `ci.yml` makes retired prose a runtime dependency. This was a source inspection of
the relevant checks, not a CI execution or a claim that all legacy checks pass.

The old MCP validates a dedicated Access audience and verified service identity ([`gemini-mcp.ts#L132-L185`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/7c034569b908d3b03a8b821b7c537477a24b10f7/packages/cloudflare-workspace-mcp/src/gemini-mcp.ts#L132-L185)); new docs retain Access identity and operation scope without internal hashes or proof tokens. Owner offers are represented as a mode of the same task/job path with pull/accept/decline, not a second executor. Pending status is historical qualification, not a claim of current live behavior. |
| Retrieval quality | Main's search caller enforces project scope and reads native results in [`project-search.ts`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/7c034569b908d3b03a8b821b7c537477a24b10f7/packages/cloudflare-ai/src/project-search.ts#L79-L176); source-backed citations are resolved against retained bytes in [`saved-citation-readback.ts`](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-research/blob/7c034569b908d3b03a8b821b7c537477a24b10f7/packages/cloudflare-evidence/src/saved-citation-readback.ts#L298-L340). | The revised retrieval section specifies multilingual Qwen3 embeddings, native BM25/vector RRF, a threshold that retains lexical hits, coherent section/table reads, optional language-appropriate reranking and explicit comparison coverage. It keeps revision prefilters and adds a small post-assembly check of recall, exact citation anchoring, unsupported output and partial scope. No quality, latency or scale results were measured in this documentation review. |

The source evidence above supports what the old interface and handlers implement; it does not establish current use,
provider credentials, live agent readiness, production counts or performance. This follow-up performed no tests and makes
no runtime-remediation claim.
